title: "Exam3Rnotes"

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(dplyr)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
dbWriteTable(con, "mpg", ggplot2::mpg, overwrite = TRUE)

mpg_db <- tbl(con, "mpg")
```

```{r}
mpg_db |>
  filter(class == "suv") |>
  select(manufacturer, model, hwy) |>
  show_query()
```
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT manufacturer, model, hwy
  FROM mpg
  WHERE class = 'suv'
")
```
